![Neat’s beautifully simple video devices are easy to install, set up, and use.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Neats-beautifully-simple-video-devices-are-easy-to-install-set-up-and-use.png)

As your meeting environments expand across rooms and locations, maintaining a consistent collaboration experience becomes more difficult. Small differences in technology, room setup, and workflows can slow meetings down while creating more work for your IT team.

In [“Building a Scalable Model for Meeting Room Standardization](https://avispl.com/resource/scalable-meeting-room-standardization/),” discover how to establish standards that can support different room types and remain aligned as your needs change.

You’ll also see how [Shure](https://avispl.com/shure/), [Neat](https://avispl.com/neat/), [Q-SYS](https://avispl.com/q-sys/), and AVI-SPL support more consistent meeting experiences across a range of spaces.

## Inside the eBook

- Learn what to standardize across room types to create a more consistent experience from space to space

- Explore a five-stage framework to assess where your organization is today and identify what may come next

- Discover how accessibility and sustainability can become part of your meeting room standards from the start

- See what helps keep meeting room standards aligned as environments grow

### Maintain consistency over time

Meeting room standardization evolves with your spaces and collaboration needs. AVI-SPL helps you put those standards into practice and maintain them over time.

[Download the eBook](https://avispl.com/resource/scalable-meeting-room-standardization/)

If you’re evaluating your meeting room technology strategy, [contact AVI-SPL to continue the conversation](https://avispl.com/contact-us/).
